about: Live baseline of the old Library Site, timed by scripts/check_library_perf.js from a GitHub runner (the Claude Code container cannot reach the Site). Milestones follow the old Site's markup in sites/library/components/library/library-app.tsx (shelf heading h2, collection card caption title, the .empty-state loading panel) and reader.tsx (the reading h1 and the first lyric line). No probe is configured here: the immediate-action probe is defined per pair when the native tab is measured against this same Site, so both sides carry the same probe.
